caption:
By impressions, from the last 90 days of this page:

1. await inside forEach: the toast fires before the uploads finish. Use for...of or Promise.all. (19,215)
2. var in a setTimeout loop prints 3 3 3. let gives each loop its own i. (13,582)
3. A div with onClick can't be reached with Tab. Use a <button>. (13,157)
4. 100vh hides the Pay button behind phone toolbars. Use 100dvh. (13,003)
5. Array(3).fill([]) shares one array across every row. Use Array.from. (12,964)

None is exotic. All five pass a quick test on a laptop and break for a real user.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master
